title: Nigeria Food Price Analysis
overview:
An interactive Power BI project analyzing food price trends across Nigerian states and markets using World Food Programme food price data.

The dashboard explores commodity price movements, market differences, geographic price distribution, and price volatility to help users understand food price patterns across Nigeria.
businessProblem: Food prices vary across locations, commodities, and time. This project provides an interactive way to compare markets, track price movements, and identify areas where prices may require further investigation.

dashboardPages.description:
Commodity price comparisons
Market price rankings
Commodity price volatility
Wholesale–retail price differences

State-level price comparisons

Price trends across locations

businessValue: The dashboard helps users explore regional food price differences, compare commodities and markets, and identify price patterns that may inform further research and decision-making.
